== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[General Poe Dameron]]: the PC card image of [[General Poe Dameron]] (2 October 2023, [[:File:V22-L-generalpoedameron.gif|V22-L-generalpoedameron.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (page 4). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
